title: sorghum anthistirioides
intro: Sorghum anthistirioides, commonly known as black sorghum, is a species of the sorghum plant, which belongs to the grass family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and aid in digestion. The therapeutic actions of black sorghum include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against various diseases and conditions. The bioactive constituents of black sorghum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
